sn45.13:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pa || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sekho sekho ti bhante vuccati || || Kittāvatā nu kho bhante sekho hotī ti || ||
sn45.13:2.1: Idha [bhikkhave] bhikkhu sekhāya sammādiṭṭhiyā sammannāgato hoti || la || sekhena sammāsamādhinā samannāgato hoti || || Ettāvatā kho bhikkhu sekho hotī ti || ||
